Delete your SSV Classes account

How to delete your account in the SSV Classes app from Shree Siddhivinayak Classes, and what happens to your data when you do.

Privacy policyDelete accountTerms of useRefund policyDelivery policy

Delete it in the app

  • Open the SSV Classes app and sign in
  • Go to Profile
  • Tap Delete account
  • Confirm that you want to delete it

Delete it without the app

Email contact@siddhivinayakclasses.org from the email address registered on your account, with the subject "Delete my account". Include your Student ID if you know it. We delete the account within 30 days of your request.

Email us to delete your account

What we delete

  • Your account and sign-in details
  • Your profile: name, email, phone number and standard
  • Your study progress and your list of downloads
  • Your study assistant chat history
  • Reviews you have written

What we may keep

Tax and accounting law requires us to keep records of payments and orders, including Razorpay invoices. We keep these for up to 8 years and, where possible, separate them from the deleted profile.

Questions

Email contact@siddhivinayakclasses.org. We reply on working days.
